title: ASTM C 636, Section 2.
officialText: 2.4. Delete Section 2.2.4 and replace as follows: 2.2.4 Carrying channels shall be designed to support the suspended loads, and shall be a minimum 11/2 inches deep (38 mm) cold-rolled steel channel weighing 0.457 pounds per linear foot (0.707 kg/m) and shall be given an electro-galvanized, hot dipped galvanized cadmium coating, or zinc coating.
